messages:
Maya: Quick ask for Serving Wins launch assets for SDR outreach. Need: 1) one-page SDR leave-behind PDF (A4) + editable PPTX, 2) compact benchmark tile (1200x675 PNG + SVG) showing cost vs median latency, 3) email header (600x200), 4) three social crops (1:1, 9:16, 16:9). Keep copy short — one headline + 2 bullets. Attach CSV for chart. Deadline = Tue 10am. @Diego @June
Diego: on it. Can you confirm whether competitor points should be labeled? also need CSV and preferred color tokens.
Maya: anonymize competitors into clusters; highlight "recommended config" callout. CSV here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE_SDR_CSV (view). Use headline: "Serve smarter: faster inference, lower cost." Bullets: 1) predictable latency, 2) lower per-token spend.
June: brand quicks: use Redwood Blue for primary lines, Ink for type. No gradients on data viz. Stacked lockup on hero, horizontal in footer. Min clearspace = 16px. I'll paste swatches in Figma.
Tom: need editable PPTX for SDRs (so reps can add notes). Also include a single-slide HTML export for email.
Diego: ETA for first comps Mon 6pm. I'll export PNG @2x, SVG, and PPTX. Will include alt text in Figma descriptions.
OpsBot: Figma file created and shared: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/sdr-serving-wins. Prototype pages: OnePager, BenchmarkTile, Socials, EmailHeader.
Maya: please name exports: servingwins_sdr_onepager_A4_v1.pdf, servingwins_bench_1200x675_v1.png. Tag the sheet row "approved_for_publish" after Legal signs off.
June: legal note: no absolute % claims without provenance. Request CSV provenance & API run IDs.
Maya: will attach provenance and ping legal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
notes: SDR leave-behind + benchmark tile request; includes Figma link, CSV, UTMs handled in separate thread.
